notes.21.13b: The whole line is restored in the edition.
notes.18.10c: 18.10c: s:ms 'bring, lead' is uncertain; 'water for drinking' (mw swr) is the label of an offering. 20.11b.1: mḏd 'press' or 'strike'. 21.13a.1 is wholly restored; ḥng is not understood, and wj may be the exclamatory 'how' or the pronoun 'me'.
notes.479.989b: m-ṭp hrw: 'at the start of the day', or 'on the day (when) he purified himself'.

nodes.text: Words to be spoken: He has brought him to himself. | Water for drinking.
[Words to be spoken: O] Pepi, I have come seeking you;
I have pressed(?) your mouth for you;
I am your son whom you love.
I have opened your mouth for you.
[Words to be spoken: How *ḥng* is your mouth!]
[I have opened your mouth for you, I have opened your two eyes for you.]
Pepi Neferkare goes up at the start of the day, having purified himself in the Field of Reeds.
The earth rises under the feet of Pepi Neferkare;
Tefnut, she grasps the arm of Pepi Neferkare.
It is Sokar who purifies Pepi Neferkare;
it is Ra who gives his arm to Pepi Neferkare.
So Pepi Neferkare goes forward to the front of the Ennead.
They have come to Osiris at the sound of the crying of Isis and Nephthys.
Raise yourself, Osiris, son of Geb, his firstborn, at whom the Great Ennead trembles!
